title: Can $1,000 really become $1 million through algo trading?
author: Ok_Foundation_857
selftext:
​

My younger brother started algo trading around April 2026. I gave him around ₹1,000 initially, and he claims that through compounding he has now turned it into around $1 million.

He sometimes shows me his wallet and says that the profits are from his trading. He says the funds/profits can be seen in his Binance wallet.

I don't know much about algo trading, so I'm genuinely confused.

Is it actually possible to turn ₹1,000 into $1 million in around 6 months through algorithmic crypto trading and compounding?

How much profit can a successful algo trader realistically make? And what should I check in the Binance wallet/trading history to verify whether the profits are actually from trading?

I'm not accusing him of anything — I just want to understand whether this is realistically possible.

Any experienced traders here, please explain. 🙏
